final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm AS timing, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(group_avg), AVG(difference) FROM kept
